firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg / 390-first.jpg: h1 has trade+method+city, one primary CTA plus call, a clean two-line proof stack, and the trowel-on-joint art now reads as a tool working. The hero is still a flat front-on tile and the 12px stage legend under it needs a second look (-0.5).

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg services laid as a running-bond wall; Italianate facade band (1440-scroll-50.jpg); joint-course dividers throughout. The cream+brick palette is the niche default, shared with library/cards/mason-C.jpg (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: strong Manrope statement; mono now limited to stages, prices and tags; the objection pull line is now sans (1440-full.jpg). The display-size mono '04 Tool' readout is a fourth voice beside the h2 (1440-scroll-25.jpg) (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg: clean tone alternation; about is balanced, the services wall fills, and the pin fills its band (1440-scroll-25.jpg). In #tools the Price it button floats alone under a short result panel, leaving the right column half empty (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

photo.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg Italianate rows and the 1440-full.jpg chimney give varied subjects with raking light; nothing broken. The about 'concave joint' is shaded convex, like proud rods (1440-full.jpg, 390-full.jpg) (-0.5); the objection spalls are stamped identical lozenges with halos (1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: prices carry their units, reviews are specific and Sample-labelled, the guarantee matches facts; trade-literate lines throughout (1440-full.jpg). The hero lead uses 'brick' three times in one sentence (1440-first.jpg) (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: no overflow (render.json), sticky Call/Price it, the pin collapses to a list, tabs on one line, units fit, footer dark to the bottom. The services wall becomes ~1,350px of nine stacked cards and loses its bond pattern (390-full.jpg) (-0.5).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg show all content; labelled inputs; 'Review 1 of 6' (1440-scroll-75.jpg); no console errors. In reduced motion the process stage buttons have no visible affordance beyond a bordered box (1440-rm-full.jpg) (-0.5).

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the pin advances to the tooled joint with the jointer, in sync with the list; the hero trowel works the joint; the checklist fill is signature-tied. The divider progress is a ~60px sliver, barely visible (1440-scroll-50.jpg) (-0.5).

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg full-width four-stage joint, the brick-bond services wall and the Italianate band (1440-scroll-50.jpg) are three memorable beats, and the checklist links back to the stages. The checklist result at rest is a near-empty bar (1440-full.jpg #tools) (-0.5).

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: the about dashed frame line runs through the caption text (-0.5); service-title arrows are glued to the words and orphan on wrap ('Limestone foundation repair→', 1440-full.jpg) (-0.5).

elevate.move: Light every drawn frame from one low raking source (upper left, as on the chimney) so recessed joints cast shadow and broken faces catch light across the hero, spall and about frames, turning separate drawings into one photographed wall

One detail pass on the system: a dashed-frame rule that never touches text, one spaced arrow glyph that never orphans, and an identical caption treatment under every drawn frame, so the page reads as made by one hand
